BOTTOM, left of the bottle: a round black seal with a thin fuchsia rim, three small stars on top and bold white uppercase text. BOTTOM RIGHT EDGE: a row of three thin-line white icons (a leaf, a capsule, a heart), each with a tiny white label below.
